statement: Onafhankelijk akkoord voor E1.3: Eva koos zelf een nieuwe controle, gebruikte echte huisgegevens, bewaarde het resultaat met bewezen teruglezing en leverde het privé af bij de juiste ontvanger. De start was transparant gestimuleerd na een eigenaaropdracht. Nut voor Jaap is nog niet beoordeeld; de tekst bevat een onnodig openstaande leescontrole en een onnauwkeurige tijdsaanduiding. De eerdere mislukte taak blijft mislukt.
verified: Actual model-selected new contribution from real permitted context
Ordinary installed adoption and native worker execution
Current source receipt and equal saved/observed content from separate remote readback
Stored result, original parent/spec binding and current private recipient delivery
No old failed-task or old-grant mutation
qualityLimitations: The start was explicitly owner-requested and transparently controller-stimulated; repeated spontaneous daily household value is not established.
The model incorrectly describes an additional read as open although the separate paired remote readback succeeded. The original text is retained.
The report labels its earlier review-context time as approximate read time; actual source-read and completion times are retained separately.
The recipient has not judged the new contribution useful. I1.2 and final family acceptance remain open.
The successful task did not exercise a retained-result reader roundtrip; the new grant/remote-denial test must not be reported as such.
No general quality or efficiency superiority over Eva1 or competitors is claimed.
